items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Al Norris and I, we'd drink anything we could get our hands on. Willie Woody Smith also.

ctx.x: Al Norris and myself and Willie Woody Smith, they all died last (inaudible). Al Norris and I, we'd drink anything we could get our hands on. Willie Woody Smith also. He died, unfortunately. He was a great saxophone player. Wilcox didn't do too much of drinking, but that Al Norris and myself, we drank -- we'd drink anything.
Now, did this cause any problems between you all and Lukoford?
